question: Should OpenClaw add the permanent external-plugin `safetyDiagnostics.emit()` API and manifest `safetyEventTypes` capability, together with durable operator-readable AI-safety history?
rationale: This is a new plugin SDK/manifest capability with privacy, retention, provenance, and operator-access consequences; a mechanical patch cannot decide whether that is the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow contract
options.body: Approve a documented, bounded event capability after defining permitted fields, retention, access controls, and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Keep it core-only
options.body: Land only internal trusted-core diagnostics and exports, leaving external plugin emission for a separately designed plugin API.

options.title: Move extensibility out of core
options.body: Keep optional third-party detectors and their event model in a plugin or ClawHub package until a general diagnostics capability model exists.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow contract
recommendation.body: Approve a documented, bounded event capability after defining permitted fields, retention, access controls, and compatibility expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies skoya as the author of the parent request and the feature series, though maintainer approval is still required.
